body_text:
How to Prep Your Hair for Holiday Travel

Holiday travel can take a real toll on your hair—especially if you wear extensions. Airplane cabins are dry, hotel water can be harsh, and winter weather creates instant frizz. The good news? A little prep before you head out keeps your hair looking smooth, voluminous, and flawless your entire trip. Here’s your Studio One guide to making holiday travel hair feel effortless.

Holiday Hair Travel Essentials: What to Pack

To protect your investment, pack smart—not heavy. This season, Studio One created Holiday Travel Packs that give you everything you need:

✨ Regular-size texture spray for home (so you don’t run out during the holidays) ✨ Travel-size texture spray ✨ Travel-size dry shampoo

Texture spray is an absolute must—especially for extension wearers. It gives your hair volume, fluff, and support, helping you revive your style after long flights, hats, or a busy day of sightseeing.

Your must-pack hair essentials include:

Dry shampoo: Refreshes roots and extends your style.

Texture spray: Adds body and life to keep your style bouncy and full.

Hydrating conditioner or mask: Replenishes moisture lost during travel.

Lightweight oil: Keeps ends smooth and prevents tangling.

Detangling brush: Essential for protecting extension rows.

Heat protectant: Always pack it, even on vacation.

Shop stylist-curated travel favorites in the Studio One Shop, and visit our Service Menu if you want a fresh blowout before your trip.

Best Hairstyles for Traveling

Holiday travel calls for hairstyles that protect your extensions while keeping you comfortable.

Low Loose Braid

Perfect for preventing tangles without creating harsh bends.

Low Bun

Keeps hair tidy and protected during long flights or drives.

Half-Up Clip

A cute, low-tension option that keeps hair out of your face.

Silk-Friendly Pony

Use a silk scrunchie to avoid damage and creasing.

Need inspiration? Visit our Hair Gallery for Studio One looks that travel beautifully.

How to Stop Hair From Frizzing on Holiday

Whether you’re headed to the snow, the desert, or a beach resort, frizz is the number-one holiday culprit. Here’s how to keep your hair smooth and photo-ready:

Hydrate Before You Go

A moisturizing conditioner or mask preps your hair for changing climates.

Travel With Silk

A silk pillowcase or scarf reduces friction and helps extensions stay frizz-free.

Brush Regularly

Brushing distributes natural oils and keeps the cuticle smooth.

Avoid Overwashing

Overwashing dries the hair out. Use your travel-size dry shampoo instead.

Seal Your Ends

A small amount of oil eliminates flyaways and helps protect from dryness.

For more expert hair tips, check out the Studio One Blog.
